collection.title: Peugeot Expert 2007 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Peugeot Expert 2007 to 2016 will fit, this model requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Expert which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
